fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate confirmed. The entrance from Pocahontas Trail (NE) is an open perimeter drive; perimeter is vegetation-buffered rather than hard-fenced. Street View is vegetation-screened, so gate/booth control could not be verified. truckGate = false on the evidence, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth confirmed (SV screened). guardShack false; no confirmed gate so remoteGs also false.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long perimeter/approach drive from Pocahontas Trail around to the SW docks.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: SW dock apron of the main plant plus a west warehouse dock face; ~25-50 band (estimate).
fieldNotes.dropArea: Modest trailer staging near the SW docks (~10-25).
fieldNotes.railServed: The east corridor is electric transmission lines, not rail - no rail spur into the property.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Main plant (with attached process building) plus a separate long west warehouse of uncertain tenancy; treated as a single Ball facility (false), flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: James River Commerce Center on the edge of Williamsburg/Grove; wooded with low-density residential around (Rural per rubric, flagged).
